input: send the landlord the photo of the meter reading, one picture
put the bins out before the truck comes, two minutes
tap approve on that expense report, done in a second
grab batteries for the smoke alarm while i am at the shop
message the group chat about saturday, quick note
iron the shirt for tomorrow, five minutes at the board
top up the travel card on the app, barely a minute
leave a review for the plumber, he earned it, short one
auditing three years of expenses will take a solid weekend
the research for my dissertation chapter is weeks of library days
renovating the spare room is a proper project, plaster and all
i need whole mornings to draft the business plan, no way around it
the archive digitising job is hundreds of boxes, a month of work
mastering the violin piece means daily practice for a season
the product launch checklist is enormous, needs a war room week
translating grandma's letters is slow careful work, dozens of pages
the neighbour's alarm went off at dawn again, i am fuming
my shoes got soaked through on the walk, miserable
the soup was bland and the waiter vanished, worst lunch in ages
i keep stubbing my toe on that doorstep, it is out to get me
the queue for coffee took twenty minutes, twenty
my umbrella broke in the wind, second one this year
the group chat is just memes now, nobody reads anything
the heating clanks all night like a haunted house
the garden gate repair is a spring job, it can wait happily
i will renew the membership when the new year starts, not before
sorting the loft is for a rainy weekend sometime, no deadline
the old sofa can stay another year, it still sits fine
i am leaving the career course question until summer, decided
the chimney sweep is booked for autumn in my head, fine for now
replacing the curtains waits for the sales, they are only faded
the family tree project is a retirement hobby, parking it with pleasure
